documentation.content: The Check It Cloud Run fetch job (check-it-fetch) had a failed execution in the last hour. Most likely cause: the monthly Check It API token expired - rotate it (use the checkit-key-manager web app, or run rotate-token.ps1). Other causes: Drive folder permissions, or the Check It API being down. Check the execution logs: gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_run_job AND resource.labels.job_name=check-it-fetch" --limit=30 --freshness=2h --format="value(textPayload)"

conditions.displayName: Cloud Run Job check-it-fetch - failed executions > 0

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "check-it-fetch" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
